label: Two-way giving profile: y gives x being at w and withholds it at an accessible world where y exists
definition: TwoWayGiverAt F w y: y exists at w, and for some x and some world v accessible from w where y also exists, y gives x being at w (GivesTo, DEF 62dfa893-b633-4513-9790-8f9a0a3087e0) and does not give x being at v. An extensional exercise profile: giving x being and not giving it are both realized at worlds where the holder exists.
note: Analyst definition, attribution deferred. Intended reading: Met. Theta 2, 1046b (read 2026-11-23, Ross translation, http://classics.mit.edu/Aristotle/metaphysics.9.ix.html), a power 'accompanied by a rational formula is alike capable of contrary effects' ('the medical art can produce both disease and health'), read on world-relative giving: giving x being and its privation, not giving it. Theta 5, 1048a, says what decides between contraries in such a power is 'desire or will'; that is NOT typed here: the profile is satisfied alike by choice, by chance and by a varying external condition. Example: on the Thomist account, God giving a creature being and being 'free not to continue their existence' (ST I q.104 a.3 co., read 2026-11-23, https://www.newadvent.org/summa/1104.htm; navigation, no claim). Non-examples: a fixed giver (DEF 7bc1d667-fda2-4744-b055-9ba6cbe7f648); a being that gives something new at v without withholding anything given at w (that is varying giving, DEF bd4c434d-be19-43ca-936b-f33eb6c15a8c, not this form). Implies GivingVariesAt.
